items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: Who played lead at the Hollywood? In which band? At the Hollywood, with, uh, Premon.

ctx.x: Yeah. Did the, did the black bands also think of themselves as dance orchestras?

I can't answer that with any accuracy, but the, the, there were some dance bands, because I can think of some of the big bands that played, uh, for instance, out of Spanish Fort. This was what, about a 10 to 11, 12 piece band. And then some of the bands that played at the, uh, New Orleans Country Club, but they did precisely the same things. That, they'd play music, popular music, and then they'd play a couple of jazz tunes. So the, the custom was actually a New Orleans custom, rather than a band custom, or let's…
read music a lot better than Sharky. Could Sharky play second parts by ear?
